data.title: Trussardi Residences
data.about:
Trussardi Residences by Mira Development, situated in the vibrant Al Furjan area, presents an architectural masterpiece rising 11 stories high. This exquisite development blends the timeless charm of Italian design with the modern sophistication of Dubai. The development features a variety of living spaces, from 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to exclusive 2-bedroom apartments with private pools.

Overlooking a quaint community of villas and low-rise apartments, Trussardi Residences offer an unparalleled view of Dubai’s skyline.
Trussardi Residences at Al Furjan provide residents with a blend of luxury services, both complimentary and a-la-carte, for a truly distinguished living experience.

location_tile.title: Premium Living in Al Furjan
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Al Furjan, home to the Trussardi Residences by Mira Development, offers a dynamic and family-oriented atmosphere. This prime neighborhood ensures seamless connectivity with major highways and is conveniently located near iconic landmarks like Dubai Marina, Bluewaters, and Palm Jumeirah. The Trussardi Residences at Al Furjan have become a coveted choice for those in search of a contemporary and well-linked community in Dubai's core.

AREAS NEARBY:

  • 1 Minute to Discovery Gardens Metro Station
  • 8 Minutes to JBR Beach, Ain Dubai and Dubai Marina
  • 10 Minutes to Palm Jumeirah
  • 18 Minutes to Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa
  • 10 Minutes to Expo City Dubai
  • 20 Minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport
